_comment: Illustrative ledger for one feature: a manager can approve a submitted expense report. Copy to .claude/backend-engineer/ledger.json only to see the shape; the orchestrator builds the real ledger with ledger.mjs.

requirements.text: An employee can submit a draft expense report for manager approval.

journeys.start: Draft expense report open in the report form

steps.ui: Submit button on the report form

journeys.outcomeSuccess: The report status becomes submitted and it appears in the manager's approval queue.
failureBranches: A missing receipt returns a validation error and keeps the report as a draft.

interactions.reason: Switches panels in the client. No data is read or written.

gaps.title: Manager approval queue does not refresh after a submit

decisions.question: Can the employee recall a submitted report before it is approved?
